settings.heading: A clinical workflow platform for mental health treatment
settings.text: Aweris supports the full path from referral and intake through treatment planning, session documentation, homework, and follow-up care. Helping therapists reduce administrative work while keeping clinical judgment and patient care at the center.

settings.heading: Less scattered administration. More continuity between therapist and patient.

settings.heading: Bring intake, sessions, notes, plans, and patient follow-up into one guided platform.
